name: Message Queues & Storage
description: Prometheus metrics from message queue and storage exporters: Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, MinIO, Ceph/Rook

metrics.name: kafka_brokers
metrics.notes: Number of brokers in the Kafka cluster. Fewer than expected indicates broker down.

metrics.name: kafka_broker_info
metrics.notes: Information about Kafka brokers including address and ID.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partitions
metrics.notes: Number of partitions for each topic.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_current_offset
metrics.notes: Current offset of a broker at topic/partition. Rate indicates production rate.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_oldest_offset
metrics.notes: Oldest offset still available. Difference from current shows retention depth.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_in_sync_replica
metrics.notes: Number of in-sync replicas. Less than total replicas indicates under-replication.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_leader
metrics.notes: Leader broker ID for each partition. -1 indicates no leader.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_leader_is_preferred
metrics.notes: Whether the current leader is the preferred leader. 0 indicates leader moved.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_replicas
metrics.notes: Total number of replicas for each partition.

metrics.name: kafka_topic_partition_under_replicated_partition
metrics.notes: Flag indicating partition is under-replicated. Any value indicates data at risk.

metrics.name: kafka_consumergroup_current_offset
metrics.notes: Current consumption position per partition. Rate indicates consumption rate.

metrics.name: kafka_consumergroup_lag
metrics.notes: Consumer lag in messages. High lag indicates slow or stuck consumers.

metrics.name: kafka_consumergroup_lag_sum
metrics.notes: Total lag across all partitions for a consumer group.

metrics.name: kafka_consumergroup_members
metrics.notes: Number of active members in consumer group. 0 means no consumers.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queues
metrics.notes: Total number of queues. Track for queue proliferation.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_connections
metrics.notes: Total number of connections.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_channels
metrics.notes: Total number of channels.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_consumers
metrics.notes: Total number of consumers. 0 means no consumers are connected.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_messages
metrics.notes: Total messages in queue (ready + unacked). High values indicate backlog.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_messages_ready
metrics.notes: Messages ready for delivery. Backlog waiting for consumers.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_messages_unacked
metrics.notes: Messages delivered but not acknowledged. High values indicate slow processing.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_messages_bytes
metrics.notes: Total size of messages in queue in bytes.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_consumers
metrics.notes: Consumers attached to queue. 0 with messages indicates orphaned queue.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_consumer_utilisation
metrics.notes: Fraction of time consumers could receive messages. <1 indicates slow consumers.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_messages_published_total
metrics.notes: Total messages published to queue.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_disk_reads_total
metrics.notes: Messages read from disk. High rates indicate memory pressure.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_queue_disk_writes_total
metrics.notes: Messages written to disk.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_received_total
metrics.notes: Total messages received across all queues.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_delivered_total
metrics.notes: Total messages delivered to consumers.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_acknowledged_total
metrics.notes: Total messages acknowledged by consumers.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_confirmed_total
metrics.notes: Publisher confirms sent.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_routed_total
metrics.notes: Messages successfully routed to queues.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_unroutable_dropped_total
metrics.notes: Messages dropped because they couldn't be routed. Indicates misconfiguration.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_unroutable_returned_total
metrics.notes: Messages returned to publisher as unroutable (mandatory flag).

metrics.name: rabbitmq_global_messages_dead_lettered_total
metrics.notes: Messages moved to dead letter queue. Reasons: rejected, expired, maxlen.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_channel_messages_unroutable_dropped_total
metrics.notes: Per-channel unroutable messages dropped.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_connection_incoming_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Bytes received per connection.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_connection_outgoing_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Bytes sent per connection.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_connections_opened_total
metrics.notes: Connection open rate. High churn may indicate connection pooling issues.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_connections_closed_total
metrics.notes: Connection close rate.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_process_resident_memory_bytes
metrics.notes: Memory used by RabbitMQ process.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_resident_memory_limit_bytes
metrics.notes: Memory high watermark. RabbitMQ blocks publishers when exceeded.

metrics.name: rabbitmq_disk_space_available_bytes
metrics.notes: Available disk space. Low values trigger flow control.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_connections
metrics.notes: Current number of connections to NATS server.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_max_connections
metrics.notes: Maximum connections configured.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_in_msgs
metrics.notes: Total messages received by server.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_out_msgs
metrics.notes: Total messages sent by server.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_in_bytes
metrics.notes: Total bytes received.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_out_bytes
metrics.notes: Total bytes sent.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_subscriptions
metrics.notes: Number of active subscriptions.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_slow_consumers
metrics.notes: Number of slow consumers detected. Slow consumers get disconnected.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_routes
metrics.notes: Number of active routes to other servers in cluster.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_cpu
metrics.notes: CPU usage percentage.

metrics.name: gnatsd_varz_mem
metrics.notes: Memory used by NATS server in bytes.

metrics.name: gnatsd_connz_total_connections
metrics.notes: Total connections ever made. Rate indicates connection churn.

metrics.name: gnatsd_connz_pending_bytes
metrics.notes: Bytes pending in client send buffers. High values indicate backpressure.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_health_status
metrics.notes: Cluster health status. 1=healthy, 0=unhealthy.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_nodes_online_total
metrics.notes: Number of nodes online in cluster.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_nodes_offline_total
metrics.notes: Number of nodes offline. Any offline nodes indicates issues.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_drive_online_total
metrics.notes: Number of drives online in cluster.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_drive_offline_total
metrics.notes: Number of drives offline. Data may be at risk.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_capacity_raw_total_bytes
metrics.notes: Total raw capacity in the cluster.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_capacity_raw_free_bytes
metrics.notes: Free raw capacity. Low values indicate storage pressure.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_capacity_usable_free_bytes
metrics.notes: Free usable capacity accounting for erasure coding overhead.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_usage_total_bytes
metrics.notes: Total storage used in cluster.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_usage_object_total
metrics.notes: Total number of objects in cluster.

metrics.name: minio_cluster_bucket_total
metrics.notes: Total number of buckets in cluster.

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_total
metrics.notes: Total S3 API requests by operation type.

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_4xx_errors_total
metrics.notes: Client errors (4xx). Indicates invalid requests or auth failures.

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_5xx_errors_total
metrics.notes: Server errors (5xx). Indicates MinIO internal issues.

metrics.name: minio_s3_traffic_received_bytes
metrics.notes: Inbound S3 traffic in bytes.

metrics.name: minio_s3_traffic_sent_bytes
metrics.notes: Outbound S3 traffic in bytes.

metrics.name: minio_node_drive_free_bytes
metrics.notes: Free space per drive.

metrics.name: minio_node_drive_latency_us
metrics.notes: Drive operation latency in microseconds. High values indicate slow disk.

metrics.name: ceph_health_status
metrics.notes: Cluster health: 0=HEALTH_OK, 1=HEALTH_WARN, 2=HEALTH_ERR.

metrics.name: ceph_health_detail
metrics.notes: Individual health check status with severity.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_up
metrics.notes: OSD up status. 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_in
metrics.notes: OSD in cluster. 1=in, 0=out. Out OSDs don't serve data.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_metadata
metrics.notes: OSD metadata including device class and network addresses.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_numpg
metrics.notes: Number of PGs per OSD. Should be balanced across OSDs.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_r
metrics.notes: Read IOPS per OSD.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_w
metrics.notes: Write IOPS per OSD.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_r_out_bytes
metrics.notes: Read throughput in bytes per OSD.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_w_in_bytes
metrics.notes: Write throughput in bytes per OSD.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_r_latency_sum
metrics.notes: Cumulative read latency. Divide by count for average.

metrics.name: ceph_osd_op_w_latency_sum
metrics.notes: Cumulative write latency. Divide by count for average.

metrics.name: ceph_pool_metadata
metrics.notes: Pool metadata for joining with other metrics.

metrics.name: ceph_pool_stored
metrics.notes: Bytes stored in pool.

metrics.name: ceph_pool_max_avail
metrics.notes: Maximum available space in pool.

metrics.name: ceph_pool_percent_used
metrics.notes: Pool utilization percentage.

metrics.name: ceph_pool_objects
metrics.notes: Number of objects in pool.

metrics.name: ceph_mon_quorum_status
metrics.notes: Monitor quorum membership. 1=in quorum, 0=out.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_total
metrics.notes: Total placement groups in cluster.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_active
metrics.notes: Number of active PGs.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_clean
metrics.notes: Number of clean PGs. All PGs should be clean in healthy cluster.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_degraded
metrics.notes: Number of degraded PGs. Indicates reduced redundancy.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_undersized
metrics.notes: PGs with fewer copies than configured replication.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_stale
metrics.notes: Stale PGs. No OSD has reported status. Data may be unavailable.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_recovering
metrics.notes: PGs currently recovering. Normal after OSD changes.

metrics.name: ceph_pg_backfilling
metrics.notes: PGs currently backfilling data to new/recovered OSDs.

metrics.name: ceph_cluster_total_bytes
metrics.notes: Total raw cluster capacity.

metrics.name: ceph_cluster_total_used_bytes
metrics.notes: Total raw storage used.

metrics.name: ceph_healthcheck_slow_ops
metrics.notes: Number of slow operations. Indicates performance issues.
